sample_unit: synthetic test discharge letters (plus 30 real-world discharge letters)

links.outcome: Extraction correctness on real-world discharge letters versus synthetic test set performance
links.effect: Synthetic test F1 0.99 for medications and 0.63 for OPS codes; physician-rated real-world case-level correctness was 78.9% ICD, 86.1% tumor, 93.0% medications, 61.3% procedures.
links.quote: When evaluated by physicians on real-world discharge letters, the model achieved case-level correctness rates of 78.9% for International Classification of Diseases diagnoses, 86.1% for tumor-related information, 93.0% for medications, and 61.3% for procedures.

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning open-source LLMs on synthetic data generated from structured FHIR records for privacy-preserving clinical information extraction

screen.reason: The study develops and validates a method for training an LLM on synthetic FHIR-derived data to extract structured medical entities from clinical discharge letters, evaluated on a benchmark and a small sample of real-world letters reviewed by clinicians. It does not test a deployment practice or organizational safeguard.
